evidence.settings_format: [PleaseDoBetter] header with force_miraculous=0/1 and reward_multiplier=1..5; no backward compatibility; primary INI only, explicit Save.

limitations: Fresh Eden log and installed hash confirm r23 loading. Individual player-page quantity, Palico exclusion, appraisal/collection, persistence and consecutive-quest checks were not separately reported.
Log contains HLE/keyboard and Maxwell assertions plus an unmapped-memory error; no clean-run or clean-shutdown claim. These emulator messages are not attributed to the plugin.
Native inventory capacity and the 150-entry appraisal queue remain; unsupported records or quantity products above 32767 suppress the entire multiplier attempt.
Ryujinx and physical Switch gameplay are untested.
Unknown reward shader, target or execution paths suppress markers. On public Forge 1.4.1, closing the overlay avoids its known combined-menu/background rendering issue.
Successful cache calls do not establish CPU translation freshness; the second forced check broader role remains incompletely traced.
reason: Integer reward quantity multiplier from 1x to 5x on player result pages; companion Palico rewards remain unchanged. Mandatory [PleaseDoBetter] primary INI, explicit Save and independent Luck setting.
target: MHGU Nintendo Switch 1.4.0; Forge 1.4.1 on the user-confirmed Eden/Linux setup.
